condition: Release, loose x2 assets, warm filesystem cache; identical settings except private save paths

method.ram: Linux /proc/PID/status VmRSS; peak from kernel VmHWM, in KiB converted to MiB
method.gpu: NVIDIA-SMI per-process graphics framebuffer memory, MiB; game PID only
method.settling: 8 seconds of gameplay at each stop; medians/ranges use samples at least 3 seconds after ready
method.instrumentation: Private before/after binaries add route-driving and ready/leaving markers to GameApplication
method.baseline: Original source/header snapshot, retaining user changes preceding loading implementation
method.optimized: Current normal game code, two atlas preparation workers
limitations: One paired route measurement; not a worst-case map survey or long-session leak test
GPU peak is sampled, so sub-100-ms peaks may be missed
RSS includes resident shared mappings; it is not exclusive private heap usage
RAM and GPU measurements exclude the headless isolated-save preparation process
Memory sampling run is separate from the earlier loading-time benchmark
Logical cache payload counters and NVIDIA physical framebuffer accounting are different measurements
